The EF and core teams have mostly a well distributed set of client combinations. We risk getting more weight on a client if the number of keys run by regular users is comparable to teams. In my own local network here I am seeing prysm stuck voting for the hash at slot 0 on all proposals, even after deposits are included and activated. So if we concentrate for example on prysm I'd expect  that we won' t onboard new validators.

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: Hmm, Think I may allocate keys in multiples of 12, to encourage users to try split evenly (e.g. all 4 consensus clients with their execution client choice, or full 12 combis like me)
